init.title: Control
init.description:
This box tolerates only one regulator. With evcc or the box's own ChargeControl running alongside, charging sessions abort at arbitrary points.

The floor is measured: 510 W runs stably, 459 W trips the power stage and ends the session. The box does not clamp on its own.
